text:
deploy-bot: Starting rollout: release v2.14.3 -> prod. Change window 03:00-04:00 UTC. Canary 5% on service-x. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/deploy-v2-backout (section 4 = backout). Pin: service-x@sha:abcd1234.

eva: quick heads-up — canary uses q4_0 quantized variant, right? if so, fallback path needs to be explicit.

raj: yes, canary is q4_0. Runbook section 4 lists the backout checklist and commands. I copied the minimal steps below for quick access.

simon: dropping quick links and command snippets from runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/deploy-v2-backout#section-4

simon: BACKOUT (high-level):
1) Pause canary and stop new canary allocations
2) Unpin service -> revert routing to stable model
3) Rollback image to v2.14.2 and restart pods
4) Invalidate KV/prefix caches
5) Monitor for 15m, then scale up stable if good

simon: commands (copy/paste)
```
# pause canary
kubectl label deployment service-x canary=paused --overwrite
# unpin
infractl service unpin service-x --pin=abcd1234
# rollback
kubectl set image deployment/service-x service-x=registry/redwood/service-x:v2.14.2
# clear cache (only if safe)
redis-cli -h redis-prod -p 6379 FLUSHDB
```

ops-runbook-bot: Backout checklist received and validated. Oncall ack required before execution.

eva: I'll be on watch for metrics. Abort criteria: p95 latency > 350ms for 3m OR error rate > 1% sustained for 3m. I'll call abort if thresholds hit.

raj: prepping rollback branch and hotfix now: `git push origin rollback/v2.14.2` -> CI will produce artifact.

simon: canary can be promoted to 5% now. kicking it off.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started -> 5% traffic to q4_0 variant. Monitoring enabled (30m).

(deploy-bot) 2187654375: healthcheck alert: service-x canary error rate = 2.7% (last 2m). p50/p95 latencies nominal.

eva: saw the alert. starting abort timeline. Calling abort now.

raj: executing rollback script: `./scripts/rollback_prod.sh v2.14.2` -> initiating image rollback and unpin.

simon: unpin command ran: `infractl service unpin service-x --pin=abcd1234` -> routing back to stable. Repointing traffic.

simon: restarted pods with v2.14.2, now clearing caches as per runbook: `redis-cli -h redis-prod -p 6379 FLUSHDB`

oncall-bot: Rollback executed and verified. Canary disabled, 100% traffic on v2.14.2. Postmortem scheduled for 03:30 UTC in #postmortems.

eva: monitoring shows errors dropping back to baseline. thanks everyone — will follow up with traces for the failing canary ffwd. :thumbsup:
